composition: Frontal Slayer luxury transactional email hero — vertical 9:16 portrait, full bleed. Match the VIP Members Vault concept-board vibe: CLEAN, MINIMAL, visually appealing, editorial luxury beauty — not busy CGI diorama. Bright photoreal white marble (#FFFFFF) with subtle soft grey veins fills the entire frame edge-to-edge. Generous negative space; one clear focal subject only. MEDIUM-WIDE camera: full hero prop visible with breathing room — prop ~50–60% of frame height in lower half, NOT macro close-up, NOT subject filling 90%+ of frame. Upper third: soft airy marble + gentle light falloff for HTML text overlay — not a stark white bar. Brand palette: crimson #EB1C24, white marble, soft shadows only.
quality: Ultra-high-end commercial CGI meets luxury beauty product photography. Photoreal 3D with immersive depth but EDITED RESTRAINT — one perfect staged shot. Soft bright studio lighting, gentle shadows, subtle volumetric haze. Materials: polished marble, clear faceted quartz/crystals, scattered brilliant-cut diamonds, deep crimson rose petals, matte white fluted ceramic vase, satin ribbon. Magazine-grade airy color grading. NO glass cubes, NO acrylic display boxes, NO flat illustration or clip-art.
brandRules: Frontal Slayer brand guidelines: minimal composition (max 3 elements — one hero object + optional rose accent + optional crystal cluster). FORBIDDEN hero forms: glass cube, acrylic cube, frosted glass box, display cube, glass vitrine, membership cube, nested glass container, or any boxy transparent pedestal — these are legacy and must NOT appear. Prefer organic still-life like the VIP mood board: ceramic vase + roses, envelope, shopping bag, shipping box, padlock, diamond, hourglass. Each image communicates the email purpose in one glance. Do NOT draw any logo/wordmark in the scene — official SLAYER PNG is composited in post only where a blank seal/patch exists. NO watermarks or readable copy in the image.
designDirection: VIP Members Vault mood board (canonical reference): clean minimal still-life on bright white marble — white fluted vase with deep crimson roses + clear quartz crystals + subtle scattered brilliant-cut diamonds on the floor. Welcome template adds a virtual-salon hair anchor: NOIR gray textured plaster mannequin bust (site-accurate, not white salon plastic) with polished bone-straight center middle-part NOIR unit beside the flowers — hospitality + hair in one frame. Other templates use one purpose-specific object (envelope, bag, box). Soft studio light, premium luxury beauty brand. NEVER default to a glass cube.
logoAuthenticity: Do NOT render any logo, wordmark, seal lettering, monogram, FS symbol, SLAY SOCIETY text, or MEMBERSHIP embossing. Leave clean empty frosted/cream/wax surfaces — zero typography. Real SLAYER logo PNG is pasted after generation (with wipe patches where configured).
